Progress

34.5% overall. Percentages are the maintainers' estimate of completed and verified behavior per subsystem, weighted by importance to a playable 1:1 port. They are not measured against the original game unless a row says so.

Content formatsRenderingChassis and rigid bodySuspension kinematicsTyre forcesEngine and drivetrainAerodynamicsCollisionInput and controlsForce feedbackSoundAI driversSessions and game modesNetworkingOriginal-game validation

Content formats

70% In progress, weight 8

KN5 models, INI/LUT, ACD archives and car data readers. Skins, CSP extensions and some KN5 variants are missing.

Engine and drivetrain

65% In progress, weight 8

Torque curve, gearbox timing, clutch, RWD/FWD/AWD, centre and axle differentials, flywheel coupling.

Chassis and rigid body

60% In progress, weight 9

6-DOF body with explicit inertia, fixed 120 Hz steps and coupled suspension solving.

Aerodynamics

55% In progress, weight 4

Drag, front/rear lift with pitch moment and wing AoA curves. DRS and active elements are missing.

Suspension kinematics

45% In progress, weight 8

DWB and STRUT raw-design geometry with constraint residuals. Setup mapping and bump stops are not calibrated.

Input and controls

40% In progress, weight 4

Keyboard driving works. Gamepad and steering-wheel input are not wired in yet.

Tyre forces

40% In progress, weight 10

Pacejka-style forces with load sensitivity, friction ellipse and relaxation length. Camber thrust, thermal and wear models are missing.

Collision

35% In progress, weight 6

Static WALL impacts with friction and certified departure. Edge/vertex contact, continuous detection and car-to-car contact are missing.

Rendering

35% In progress, weight 10

wgpu renderer with diffuse, multilayer and BC textures. Original shaders, normal maps, shadows, reflections, weather and post-processing are missing.

Sessions and game modes

15% In progress, weight 5

Car and track loading with spawn checks. Race rules, timing, flags and pit logic are missing.

Original-game validation

5% Not started, weight 10

Telemetry research tooling exists. No subsystem is yet verified against recordings of the original game.
